title: Relay Queue Recovery Runbook
lead: Pause delivery before replaying events. Confirm the checkpoint, then resume in a controlled batch.
label: events in the first recovery batch
intro: This fictional runbook handles a stalled delivery queue. It demonstrates a safe sequence; adapt commands and thresholds to the actual system before operational use.
sections: Pause the worker and record the last acknowledged event ID. Confirm that the consumer is healthy before attempting a replay.
Replay the next 50 events from the checkpoint. Check duplicate handling and compare delivered IDs with acknowledgements.
Resume only when the batch reconciles and error rate remains below the agreed threshold. If it fails, pause again and retain the evidence.
closing: Synthetic operational example · Commands require environment-specific review.
prompt: Create a fictional technical document and HTML edition: Pause delivery before replaying events. Confirm the checkpoint, then resume in a controlled batch. A wide operations sheet puts the proceed-or-stop matrix before the three recovery steps; a red stop rule and batch size remain adjacent to the procedure. Preserve every source number and qualification. Use Office Code Pro for the web; keep the Word text and tables editable and inspect every rendered page.
colorDirection: Night-mode recovery runbook with cyan steps and a separately labelled red stop condition.
